Interface PurchaseOrderClient

All Superinterfaces:
Pageable<PurchaseOrder>
All Known Implementing Classes:
PurchaseOrderClientImpl
public interface PurchaseOrderClient extends Pageable<PurchaseOrder>
Internal client for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 purchase-order lookups: GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders (list) and GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders/{number} (single get).
